input: Scheduled ventures prompt: continue work on the repo aiming to develop, deploy, market, sell and support revenue generating software products (prompts/ventures/prompt-1.md brief)

errors.what: Failed-test item lists capped at 200 rows hid planted faults on files with many failures (hotel names, CCA zero durations)
A plain average across characteristics rated sample.xer 'Fully met' overall with no resources
errors.fix: no overall grade; headline is characteristics at least substantially met, plus the weakest

errors.what: First draft of eval note claimed a hand read-back of failures that was not done
errors.fix: removed before commit; note says false alarms are not measured

errors.what: inherited-keys lint flagged CSTR[...] and COLOR[...] lookups

doc_friction.issue: A background python http.server for a Playwright page check was refused by the auto-mode classifier; serving files through page.route inside the Playwright script works and could be the documented pattern
python3 is 3.11 here, so f-strings with backslashes in expressions fail; python3.12 also exists

deviations.why: Start-here said take the third open item of xer-schedule-check; every listed item needs a real outside input (a real TIA exhibit, a Project seat, a P6 import), so I built a new buildable slice on the same flagship instead: the GAO-16-89G scorecard, a standard federal schedule reviewers use that the tool lacked
deviations.result: landed with tests, page, guide, eval

notes: Local checks: python3 platform/ci/run_venture_tests.py xer-schedule-check -> ok (421 tests); gao.test.mjs 8/8; guides.test.mjs includes the GAO worked example equal to the engine; check_posts ok; validate.py ok. Playwright on the page at 390 px: example loaded, GAO scorecard rendered, no console errors, scrollWidth 390. eval/gao-check.mjs: 129/129 planted faults named on six public P6 files. venture-preflight run in background, result in PR body.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: senior scheduler-developer: GAO guide mapping, module, tests, eval harness, page, guide page, post

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
